title: Flow Nexus v1 defines and launches one configured Codex flow
description: Implement the fresh version-1 first slice: persist validated Complex definitions in binary Memory, describe and list them after restart, and launch one HarnessDefault Codex member through Belief Furnish and Herdr Create, Start, then Prompt.
design: Core owns binary definition Memory under the selected Place state directory. Define validates and atomically replaces one named Complex. Launch captures the definition, refuses unsupported harness/tools before external effects, then composes typed Furnish, Create, Start, and Prompt calls through the Flow translator. Preserve actual Belief refusals and Herdr outcomes; after Create, failures carry FlowId and Pane. No v0 machinery.
acceptance_criteria: Define survives process restart and Describe/Definitions return the stored definition. Invalid Define preserves the prior value. A configured HarnessDefault Codex member launches through Furnish, Create, Start, and Prompt; missing beliefs and typed stage failures refuse at the correct boundary. The installed CLI is flow-nexus <metaflow> <datom>, and an end-to-end proof distinguishes an assistant response from the submitted prompt. Generated public, Operation, and Emission contracts pass drift checks.
